comment: Source read at commit 2b2ad81, the only commit carrying version 2.0.10; its plugin.json is byte-identical to the installed one. The README says bands are folded back when they pass 15kHz or 20Hz; Sinensis.cpp:136-138 uses 15000 and 30, so the lower bound is 30Hz. Sinensis.cpp:129 holds if (ratio < 0) { ratio = 1 / -ratio; }, which can never run because line 120 has already clamped the ratio to 0 and above. The frequency CV is a linear hertz offset, not 1V per octave, which is why its family is cv. None of the controls carries a printed name on the panel; the artwork is pictograms.
